title: CPSC Certificate of Compliance data elements

rules.cite_title: CPSC Citations, Testing Exclusions, and Disclaims guidance
rules.failure: Provide each applicable CPSC citation as a 3–14 character code.
Provide the manufacture date as YYYY-MM.
Manufacture place must include the manufacturing party's name, full address, and contact information.
Provide the most recent product test date as YYYY-MM-DD.
Testing laboratory must include the testing entity's name, full address, and contact information.
Point of contact must include the record keeper's name, full address, and contact information.
